segments.title: Lecture notes → practice test
segments.say: Turn tonight's lecture notes into a practice test.

segments.title: Paste notes, run 3 prompts
segments.say: Paste your notes, then run three prompts.
One: summarize these notes in five bullets a beginner would understand.
Two: make ten flashcards from these notes.
Three: quiz me, one question at a time, and tell me what I got wrong.
segments.text: Quiz me: 5 questions, one at a time.

segments.title: Your notes are the source
segments.say: Then check its answers against your notes.
Save this for exam week, and follow for one prompt a day.
